visual.name: pnlByDatenWG
visual.description: IBCS-inspired P&L / GuV statement: unbalanced parent-child account hierarchy from a dimension table, subtotal and formula rows (EBITDA, margins), sign conventions with variance-invert for cost rows, scenarios AC/PY/PL/FC with delta bars and delta-percent pins against a selectable reference, expand/collapse with persisted state, k/m scaling and a 3-line IBCS title block. Four views: table, structure bars, row waterfall and a value driver tree that grows either from the formula graph (DuPont) or from a plain dimension hierarchy, with card zoom, re-root and breadcrumb.
